data.description: Can catch small, medium, or large rocks. 1/round, you can catch a rock (or similarly shaped projectile) that would hit you by making a reflex save to catch it as a free action. The DC is 15 for small, 20 for medium, and 25 for large. If the attack had a magic bonus, add it to the DC. You need to be aware of the attack to use this ability.
data.name: Rock Catching
